title: Encoding and decoding jumps
hints: Compute each candidate displacement from that form's own end: `to - (from + 2)` for the short jump, `to - (from + 5)` for the near one. Doing the subtraction in `std::uint64_t` and casting the result to `std::int64_t` gives the right signed distance.
To decode, read the displacement as a **signed** value (`std::int8_t` or `std::int32_t`) and add it to the address just past the instruction.
